1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 15 m de altura, con tronco de corteza rugosa y amplia copa, hojas compuestas, alternas y pecioladas, y flores hermafroditas agrupadas en racimos. Fabaceae, Prosopis algarrobilla.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 15 m, with a trunk having rough bark and a broad canopy, compound leaves that are alternate and petiolate, and hermaphroditic flowers grouped in racemes. Fabaceae, Prosopis algarrobilla.
